newsitem.title: USA: Trico Marine sets 2-for-1 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Trico Marine sets 2-for-1 stock split.

text.p: Trico Marine Services Inc said Thursday it had approved a two-for-one stock split, payable June 9, record May 23.
The split subject to shareholder approval of an increase in authorized common stock to 40 million shares from 15 million at the annual meeting May 22.
The company has about 8.5 million shares of common and common stock equivalents outstanding.
Trico Marine provides marine support services to the oil and gas industry, primarily in the Gulf of Mexico and Brazil.
